messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to lock the Console telemetry & retention plan for the upcoming OKR cycle. Customers asking for 90d traces + 12mo metrics in some cases. We need: retention tiers, default sampling, cost guardrails, and GA launch criteria.
sam: Can we put a short checklist for launch criteria? e.g., perf SLOs, cost delta <15%, migration path + UX, 2 pilot customers signed.
mohit: Cost is the kicker. Long traces at full sampling blow GPU/TSDB storage. Propose: default trace retention 30d with configurable paid tiers; adaptive sampling for high-volume services.
carlos: quick E2E estimate — using recent ingest numbers: 200k spans/day -> avg span size 1.2KB -> 200k * 1.2KB * 90d = ~21.6GB raw, ~x3 after indexing -> ~65GB per service. multiply by 50 large customers = 3.2TB.
carlos: code snippet for cost calc:
```
# rough
spans_per_day = 200000
span_kb = 1.2
days = 90
indexed_multiplier = 3
total_gb = spans_per_day * span_kb * days * indexed_multiplier / 1024
print(total_gb)
```
reina: UX note — retention controls must be discoverable and defaulted conservatively. We should avoid shipping a config that's easy to mis-set and explode cost. Maybe a guided tier selector (Essential / Business / Enterprise) with clear cost impact.
kai: Operational note — migration from short->long retention needs background backfill; that'll spike ingestion. We must either throttle backfills or require paid migration window.
elsa: +1 to throttled backfills and explicit quota bump process. Also, add trace sampling presets per language runtime (node/go/python).
sam: For launch criteria draft: 1) latency overhead of telemetry <5% for probes; 2) cost forecast within 10% of budget for top 10 customers; 3) UX flow + docs + migration runbook; 4) 2 paying beta customers + one compliance checklist (SOC2 / logs retention). Thoughts?
mohit: Agree. Add: auto-fallback policy if storage exceeds threshold (auto-reduce retention + notify admin). Implementation: small feature.
elaine: Decision point: do we ship with 30d default + paid 90/365 tiers, or 7d default + paid tiers? Product leaning toward 30d to reduce friction for observability parity with competitors.
carlos: If default 30d, we need stronger sampling and aggressive dedup/index compaction. Ops cost delta ~2.1x vs 7d.
retention-bot: Reminder — Customer: AcmeCorp requested 180d trace retention for compliance on 1874999000. Ticket: RD-4821.
sam: OK action items: @mohit scope sampling + auto-fallback work (spike this week), @carlos finish cost model by Wed, @reina sketch tier selector flows by Thu, @kai run migration backfill playbook and estimate ops impact. I'll draft launch criteria doc and share.
elaine: Thanks — we'll reconvene Fri 10am to finalize OKR mapping. If anyone has hard blockers before then drop a note here. :thumbsup:
